```{r packages}
library(tidyverse)
library(here)

eval_start <- ymd("2012-01-01")   # first forecast origin (extended evaluation)
out_dir    <- here("data", "evaluation", "from2012")
dir.create(out_dir, showWarnings = FALSE)
horizons   <- c(4, 8)             # quarters ahead
```

## Step 1: Target, headline inflation (year-over-year, quarterly)

```{r}
target <- readRDS(here("data", "svar", "cpi_q_sa.rds")) |>
  arrange(date) |>
  transmute(date, pi = 100 * (cpi / lag(cpi, 4) - 1)) |>
  filter(!is.na(pi))
range(target$date); nrow(target)
saveRDS(target, file.path(out_dir, "target_headline_yoy_q.rds"))
```

## Step 2: Forecasting engine (direct, recursive)

```{r}
# forecast pi(t+h) from predictors at t, re-estimated at each origin using only past data
direct_fc <- function(df, h, predictors, origins, offset_pi = FALSE) {
  df  <- df |> arrange(date) |> mutate(y_lead = lead(pi, h))
  rhs <- if (offset_pi) c(predictors, "offset(pi)") else predictors     # offset: coefficient on pi fixed at 1
  map_dfr(origins, \(o) {
    train <- df |>
      filter(date <= o %m-% months(3 * h),
             if_all(all_of(c("y_lead", "pi", predictors)), \(x) !is.na(x)))
    fit <- lm(reformulate(rhs, "y_lead"), data = train)
    tibble(origin = o, h = h, target_date = o %m+% months(3 * h),
           forecast = as.numeric(predict(fit, filter(df, date == o))))
  })
}

fc_data   <- target |> mutate(pi_lag1 = lag(pi))
origins_h <- function(h) fc_data$date[fc_data$date >= eval_start &
                                      fc_data$date %m+% months(3 * h) <= max(fc_data$date)]
```

## Step 3: Benchmark forecasts

```{r}
bench <- map_dfr(horizons, \(h) {
  o <- origins_h(h)
  bind_rows(
    fc_data |> filter(date %in% o) |>
      transmute(origin = date, h = h, target_date = date %m+% months(3 * h),
                forecast = pi, model = "Random walk"),
    direct_fc(fc_data, h, c("pi", "pi_lag1"), o) |> mutate(model = "AR(2)"),
    map_dfr(o, \(x) tibble(origin = x, h = h, target_date = x %m+% months(3 * h),
                           forecast = mean(fc_data$pi[fc_data$date <= x]))) |>
      mutate(model = "Historical mean")
  )
}) |>
  left_join(select(target, target_date = date, actual = pi), by = "target_date")
saveRDS(bench, file.path(out_dir, "forecasts_benchmarks.rds"))

acc <- bench |>
  group_by(model, h) |>
  summarise(n    = n(),
            rmse = sqrt(mean((actual - forecast)^2)),
            mae  = mean(abs(actual - forecast)),
            bias = mean(actual - forecast), .groups = "drop") |>
  group_by(h) |>
  mutate(rel_rmse = rmse / rmse[model == "Random walk"]) |>
  ungroup() |>
  mutate(across(c(rmse, mae, bias, rel_rmse), \(x) round(x, 2)))
acc

p_bench <- bench |>
  ggplot(aes(target_date)) +
  geom_line(aes(y = actual), colour = "grey40", linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_line(aes(y = forecast, colour = model)) +
  facet_wrap(~ paste(h, "quarters ahead"), ncol = 1) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Headline inflation, year-over-year (%)", colour = NULL) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 11) + theme(legend.position = "bottom")
p_bench
ggsave(here("output", "evaluation_figures", "benchmark_forecasts_2012.png"), p_bench, width = 9, height = 7, dpi = 300)
```

## Step 4: Core measures, starting with ex-food

```{r}
# forecasts from one core measure: (1) core level as the forecast, (2) gap regression
core_fc <- function(core_q, name) {
  d <- fc_data |> left_join(core_q, by = "date") |> mutate(gap = core - pi)
  map_dfr(horizons, \(h) {
    o <- origins_h(h)
    bind_rows(
      d |> filter(date %in% o) |>
        transmute(origin = date, h = h, target_date = date %m+% months(3 * h),
                  forecast = core, model = paste(name, "(level)")),
      direct_fc(d, h, "gap", o, offset_pi = TRUE) |> mutate(model = paste(name, "(gap)"))
    )
  }) |>
    left_join(select(target, target_date = date, actual = pi), by = "target_date")
}

accuracy_tbl <- function(fc) {
  fc |>
    group_by(model, h) |>
    summarise(n    = n(),
              rmse = sqrt(mean((actual - forecast)^2)),
              mae  = mean(abs(actual - forecast)),
              bias = mean(actual - forecast), .groups = "drop") |>
    group_by(h) |>
    mutate(rel_rmse = rmse / rmse[model == "Random walk"]) |>
    ungroup() |>
    mutate(across(c(rmse, mae, bias, rel_rmse), \(x) round(x, 2))) |>
    arrange(h, rmse)
}

exfood_q <- readRDS(here("data", "exclusion", "exfood_linked_2006.rds")) |>
  mutate(date = floor_date(date, "quarter")) |>
  group_by(date) |>
  summarise(core = mean(ex_food_yoy), n = n(), .groups = "drop") |>
  filter(n == 3, !is.na(core)) |>
  select(-n)
range(exfood_q$date)

fc_exfood <- core_fc(exfood_q, "Ex-food")
saveRDS(fc_exfood, file.path(out_dir, "forecasts_exfood.rds"))

accuracy_tbl(bind_rows(bench, fc_exfood))
```

## Step 5: Local level trend in real time (recursive X-13 and model re-estimation)

```{r}
library(seasonal)
cpi_m <- readRDS(here("data", "svar", "cpi_linked_monthly.rds")) |> arrange(date)

# one vintage: everything re-estimated using CPI up to the end of origin quarter o
ll_vintage <- function(o) {
  d   <- cpi_m |> filter(date <= o %m+% months(2))
  x   <- ts(d$cpi, start = c(year(d$date[1]), month(d$date[1])), frequency = 12)
  sa  <- seas(x, regression.aictest = NULL, transform.function = "log")
  pi_sa <- 1200 * diff(log(as.numeric(final(sa))))
  fit <- StructTS(pi_sa, type = "level")
  tibble(date = d$date[-1], tau = as.numeric(fitted(fit)[, "level"])) |>
    mutate(core_yoy = 100 * (exp(zoo::rollmeanr(tau, 12, fill = NA) / 100) - 1),
           date     = floor_date(date, "quarter")) |>
    group_by(date) |>
    summarise(core = mean(core_yoy), n = n(), .groups = "drop") |>
    filter(n == 3, !is.na(core)) |>
    select(-n)
}

all_origins <- origins_h(min(horizons))
ll_rt <- map(all_origins, \(o) tryCatch(ll_vintage(o), error = \(e) NULL)) |>
  set_names(as.character(all_origins))
sum(map_lgl(ll_rt, is.null))                        # number of failed vintages (should be 0)
saveRDS(ll_rt, file.path(out_dir, "vintages_local_level.rds"))

# forecasts from real-time vintages: each origin uses its own vintage of the core history
core_fc_rt <- function(vintages, name) {
  map_dfr(horizons, \(h) map_dfr(origins_h(h), \(o) {
    d <- fc_data |>
      filter(date <= o) |>
      left_join(vintages[[as.character(o)]], by = "date") |>
      mutate(gap = core - pi, y_lead = lead(pi, h))
    tr      <- d |> filter(date <= o %m-% months(3 * h), !is.na(y_lead), !is.na(gap))
    now     <- filter(d, date == o)
    fit_gap <- lm(y_lead ~ gap + offset(pi), data = tr)     # gap regression (Cogley, 2002)
    fit_reg <- lm(y_lead ~ core, data = tr)                 # core regression: nests the historical mean
    tibble(origin = o, h = h, target_date = o %m+% months(3 * h),
           model    = paste(name, c("(level)", "(gap)", "(regression)")),
           forecast = as.numeric(c(now$core, predict(fit_gap, now), predict(fit_reg, now))))
  })) |>
    left_join(select(target, target_date = date, actual = pi), by = "target_date")
}

fc_ll <- core_fc_rt(ll_rt, "Local level")
saveRDS(fc_ll, file.path(out_dir, "forecasts_local_level.rds"))

accuracy_tbl(bind_rows(bench, fc_exfood, fc_ll))
```

## Step 6: All three forecast forms for ex-food and the local level trend

```{r}
exfood_vintages <- set_names(rep(list(exfood_q), length(all_origins)), as.character(all_origins))

fc_exfood <- core_fc_rt(exfood_vintages, "Ex-food")
fc_ll     <- core_fc_rt(ll_rt, "Local level")
saveRDS(fc_exfood, file.path(out_dir, "forecasts_exfood.rds"))
saveRDS(fc_ll,     file.path(out_dir, "forecasts_local_level.rds"))

accuracy_tbl(bind_rows(bench, fc_exfood, fc_ll)) |> as.data.frame()
```

## Step 7: SVAR core in real time

```{r}
gdp_lin <- readRDS(here("data", "svar", "gdp_linked_nsa.rds"))
cpi_qr  <- readRDS(here("data", "svar", "cpi_q_sa.rds")) |> select(date, cpi)

# seasonal adjustment with a fallback: SEATS first, X-11 if SEATS returns nothing (short series)
safe_sa <- function(x, ...) {
  s <- tryCatch(final(seas(x, ...)), error = \(e) NULL)
  if (is.null(s) || length(s) != length(x)) s <- final(seas(x, x11 = "", ...))
  as.numeric(s)
}

svar_vintage <- function(o) {
  g    <- gdp_lin |> filter(date <= o)
  cp   <- cpi_qr  |> filter(date <= o)
  g_sa <- safe_sa(ts(g$gdp, start = c(2000, 1), frequency = 4))
  c_sa <- safe_sa(ts(cp$cpi, start = c(2006, 1), frequency = 4),
                  regression.aictest = NULL, transform.function = "log")
  dat <- tibble(date = g$date,  growth = 400 * c(NA, diff(log(g_sa)))) |>
    inner_join(tibble(date = cp$date, infl = 400 * c(NA, diff(log(c_sa)))), by = "date") |>
    filter(!is.na(growth), !is.na(infl))

  vf  <- vars::VAR(as.matrix(dat[, c("growth", "infl")]), p = 1, type = "const")
  bq  <- vars::BQ(vf)
  B   <- bq$B %*% diag(c(sign(bq$LRIM[1, 1]), sign(bq$B[2, 2])))
  A1  <- vars::Acoef(vf)[[1]]
  mu  <- solve(diag(2) - A1, sapply(vf$varresult, \(m) coef(m)[["const"]]))
  eps <- resid(vf) %*% t(solve(B))

  contrib <- matrix(0, nrow(eps), 2)
  for (t in seq_len(nrow(eps))) {
    contrib[t, ] <- A1 %*% (if (t == 1) c(0, 0) else contrib[t - 1, ]) + B[, 2] * eps[t, 2]
  }
  tibble(date = dat$date[-1], core_q = mu[2] + contrib[, 2]) |>
    mutate(p_core = cumsum(core_q / 400),
           core   = 100 * (exp(p_core - lag(p_core, 4)) - 1)) |>
    filter(!is.na(core)) |>
    select(date, core)
}

svar_rt <- map(all_origins, \(o) tryCatch(svar_vintage(o), error = \(e) NULL)) |>
  set_names(as.character(all_origins))
sum(map_lgl(svar_rt, is.null))                      # failed vintages (should be 0)
saveRDS(svar_rt, file.path(out_dir, "vintages_svar.rds"))

fc_svar <- core_fc_rt(svar_rt, "SVAR")
saveRDS(fc_svar, file.path(out_dir, "forecasts_svar.rds"))

accuracy_tbl(bind_rows(bench, fc_exfood, fc_ll, fc_svar)) |> as.data.frame()
```

## Step 8: Dynamic factor model in real time

```{r}
# the 10 divisions used in the DFM (2023 base), plus headline
dfm_codes <- c("Хүнсний бараа, ундаа, ус"                      = "food",
               "Согтууруулах ундаа, тамхи"                     = "alcohol_tobacco",
               "Хувцас, бөс бараа, гутал"                      = "clothing",
               "Орон сууц, ус, цахилгаан, түлш"                = "housing_utilities",
               "Гэр ахуйн тавилга, гэр ахуйн бараа"            = "furnishings",
               "Эм тариа, эмнэлгийн үйлчилгээ"                 = "health",
               "Тээвэр"                                        = "transport",
               "Амралт, чөлөөт цаг, соёлын бараа, үйлчилгээ"   = "recreation",
               "Зочид буудал, зоогийн газар, дотуур байр"      = "restaurants_hotels",
               "Бусад бараа, үйлчилгээ"                        = "other")

div_m <- readRDS(here("data", "exclusion", "division_indices_linked_2006.rds")) |>
  filter(code %in% unname(dfm_codes)) |>
  bind_rows(readRDS(here("data", "svar", "cpi_linked_monthly.rds")) |>
              transmute(date, code = "headline", index = cpi))

# seasonally adjusted, annualized monthly inflation from one index (NA if X-13 fails)
sa_infl <- function(idx, start_date) {
  x  <- ts(idx, start = c(year(start_date), month(start_date)), frequency = 12)
  sa <- tryCatch(final(seas(x, regression.aictest = NULL, transform.function = "log")),
                 error = \(e) NULL)
  if (is.null(sa)) return(rep(NA_real_, length(idx) - 1))
  1200 * diff(log(as.numeric(sa)))
}

# Stock-Watson outlier rule: values more than 6 IQRs from the median -> median of previous 5 months
clean_outliers <- function(x) {
  bad <- abs(x - median(x, na.rm = TRUE)) > 6 * IQR(x, na.rm = TRUE)
  for (i in which(bad)) if (i > 1) x[i] <- median(x[max(1, i - 5):(i - 1)], na.rm = TRUE)
  x
}

dfm_vintage <- function(o) {
  infl <- div_m |>
    filter(date <= o %m+% months(2)) |>
    arrange(code, date) |>
    group_by(code) |>
    reframe(date = date[-1], pi = sa_infl(index, date[1]))
  wide <- infl |> pivot_wider(names_from = code, values_from = pi) |> arrange(date)

  X <- wide |> select(all_of(unname(dfm_codes))) |> mutate(across(everything(), clean_outliers))
  X <- X[, colSums(is.na(X)) == 0]                  # drop any division whose X-13 failed
  X <- scale(X)

  pc <- prcomp(X, center = FALSE, scale. = FALSE)
  f  <- pc$x[, 1] * sign(mean(pc$rotation[, 1]))    # sign: factor rises with inflation
  reg <- tibble(date = wide$date, pi = wide$headline, f = f)
  fit <- lm(pi ~ f, data = reg)

  reg |>
    mutate(dfm_m    = fitted(fit),
           core_yoy = 100 * (exp(zoo::rollmeanr(dfm_m, 12, fill = NA) / 100) - 1),
           date     = floor_date(date, "quarter")) |>
    group_by(date) |>
    summarise(core = mean(core_yoy), n = n(), .groups = "drop") |>
    filter(n == 3, !is.na(core)) |>
    select(-n)
}

dfm_rt <- map(all_origins, \(o) tryCatch(dfm_vintage(o), error = \(e) NULL)) |>
  set_names(as.character(all_origins))
sum(map_lgl(dfm_rt, is.null))                       # failed vintages (should be 0)
saveRDS(dfm_rt, file.path(out_dir, "vintages_dfm.rds"))

fc_dfm <- core_fc_rt(dfm_rt, "DFM")
saveRDS(fc_dfm, file.path(out_dir, "forecasts_dfm.rds"))
```

## Step 9: Combine all forecasts (UC-SV and fat-tailed excluded: they start in 2010)

```{r}
fc_all <- bind_rows(bench, fc_exfood, fc_ll, fc_svar, fc_dfm)
saveRDS(fc_all, file.path(out_dir, "forecasts_all.rds"))
accuracy_tbl(fc_all) |> as.data.frame()
```

## Step 10: Equal-weighted combination of core measures (regression forms)

```{r}
fc_all  <- fc_all |> filter(model != "Equal-weighted combination")   # remove any earlier copy, so reruns are safe
fc_comb <- fc_all |>
  filter(str_detect(model, "\\(regression\\)")) |>
  group_by(origin, h, target_date, actual) |>
  summarise(forecast = mean(forecast), .groups = "drop") |>
  mutate(model = "Equal-weighted combination")

fc_all <- bind_rows(fc_all, fc_comb)
saveRDS(fc_all, file.path(out_dir, "forecasts_all.rds"))
```

## Step 11: Diebold-Mariano and Clark-West tests

```{r}
# Newey-West (Bartlett) long-run variance
hac_var <- function(x, lags) {
  n <- length(x); x <- x - mean(x)
  v <- sum(x^2) / n
  for (l in seq_len(lags)) v <- v + 2 * (1 - l / (lags + 1)) * sum(x[(l + 1):n] * x[1:(n - l)]) / n
  v
}

# Diebold-Mariano with Harvey-Leybourne-Newbold correction; positive = model beats benchmark
dm_test <- function(e_bench, e_model, h) {
  d <- e_bench^2 - e_model^2; n <- length(d)
  stat <- mean(d) / sqrt(hac_var(d, h - 1) / n) * sqrt((n + 1 - 2 * h + h * (h - 1) / n) / n)
  c(dm = stat, p_dm = 2 * pt(-abs(stat), df = n - 1))
}

# Clark-West for nested models; one-sided: does the larger model add information?
cw_test <- function(e_null, e_alt, f_null, f_alt, h) {
  adj <- e_null^2 - (e_alt^2 - (f_null - f_alt)^2); n <- length(adj)
  stat <- mean(adj) / sqrt(hac_var(adj, h - 1) / n)
  c(cw = stat, p_cw = pnorm(-stat))
}

errs <- fc_all |> mutate(e = actual - forecast)
bm   <- errs |> filter(model %in% c("Historical mean", "Random walk")) |>
  select(origin, h, model, e, forecast) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = model, values_from = c(e, forecast))

tests <- errs |>
  filter(!model %in% c("Historical mean", "Random walk")) |>
  left_join(bm, by = c("origin", "h")) |>
  group_by(model, h) |>
  summarise(
    rmse  = sqrt(mean(e^2)),
    rel_mean = rmse / sqrt(mean(`e_Historical mean`^2)),
    as_tibble_row(dm_test(`e_Historical mean`, e, first(h))) |> rename(dm_vs_mean = dm, p_vs_mean = p_dm),
    as_tibble_row(dm_test(`e_Random walk`, e, first(h)))     |> rename(dm_vs_rw = dm,   p_vs_rw = p_dm),
    as_tibble_row(cw_test(`e_Historical mean`, e, `forecast_Historical mean`, forecast, first(h))),
    .groups = "drop") |>
  mutate(p_cw = if_else(str_detect(model, "\\(regression\\)"), p_cw, NA_real_),
         cw   = if_else(str_detect(model, "\\(regression\\)"), cw,   NA_real_)) |>
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric) & !h, \(x) round(x, 3))) |>
  arrange(h, rmse)
saveRDS(tests, file.path(out_dir, "forecast_tests.rds"))

tests |> filter(str_detect(model, "regression|combination|AR")) |> as.data.frame()
```

## Step 12: Does core add information beyond current inflation? (inflation + core vs. inflation only)

```{r}
aug_fc <- function(vintages, name) {
  map_dfr(horizons, \(h) map_dfr(origins_h(h), \(o) {
    d <- fc_data |>
      filter(date <= o) |>
      left_join(vintages[[as.character(o)]], by = "date") |>
      mutate(y_lead = lead(pi, h))
    tr  <- d |> filter(date <= o %m-% months(3 * h), !is.na(y_lead), !is.na(core))
    now <- filter(d, date == o)
    tibble(origin = o, h = h, target_date = o %m+% months(3 * h), measure = name,
           f_null = as.numeric(predict(lm(y_lead ~ pi,        data = tr), now)),
           f_alt  = as.numeric(predict(lm(y_lead ~ pi + core, data = tr), now)))
  })) |>
    left_join(select(target, target_date = date, actual = pi), by = "target_date")
}

aug <- bind_rows(aug_fc(exfood_vintages, "Ex-food"),
                 aug_fc(ll_rt,           "Local level"),
                 aug_fc(svar_rt,         "SVAR"),
                 aug_fc(dfm_rt,          "DFM"))
saveRDS(aug, file.path(out_dir, "forecasts_augmented.rds"))

aug |>
  mutate(e_null = actual - f_null, e_alt = actual - f_alt) |>
  group_by(measure, h) |>
  summarise(rmse_infl_only = sqrt(mean(e_null^2)),
            rmse_infl_core = sqrt(mean(e_alt^2)),
            as_tibble_row(cw_test(e_null, e_alt, f_null, f_alt, first(h))), .groups = "drop") |>
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric) & !h, \(x) round(x, 3))) |>
  arrange(h, p_cw) |>
  as.data.frame()
```

## Step 13: Rolling window (each forecast learns from the most recent 20 quarters only)

```{r}
win <- 20                                                   # quarters of training data

# ---- inputs, reloaded so this step is self-contained ----
target    <- readRDS(file.path(out_dir, "target_headline_yoy_q.rds"))
fc_data   <- target |> mutate(pi_lag1 = lag(pi))
origins_h <- function(h) fc_data$date[fc_data$date >= eval_start &
                                      fc_data$date %m+% months(3 * h) <= max(fc_data$date)]
all_origins <- origins_h(min(horizons))

exfood_q <- readRDS(here("data", "exclusion", "exfood_linked_2006.rds")) |>
  mutate(date = floor_date(date, "quarter")) |>
  group_by(date) |>
  summarise(core = mean(ex_food_yoy), n = n(), .groups = "drop") |>
  filter(n == 3, !is.na(core)) |>
  select(-n)

vint <- list(
  "Ex-food"     = set_names(rep(list(exfood_q), length(all_origins)), as.character(all_origins)),
  "Local level" = readRDS(file.path(out_dir, "vintages_local_level.rds")),
  "SVAR"        = readRDS(file.path(out_dir, "vintages_svar.rds")),
  "DFM"         = readRDS(file.path(out_dir, "vintages_dfm.rds")))

# training rows: outcome already known at the origin, and within the last `win` quarters
train_rows <- function(d, o, h) d |> filter(date <= o %m-% months(3 * h),
                                            date >  o %m-% months(3 * (h + win)))

# ---- benchmarks on the rolling window ----
roll_bench <- map_dfr(horizons, \(h) map_dfr(origins_h(h), \(o) {
  d   <- fc_data |> filter(date <= o) |> mutate(y_lead = lead(pi, h))
  tr  <- train_rows(d, o, h) |> filter(!is.na(y_lead))
  tr2 <- tr |> filter(!is.na(pi_lag1))
  now <- filter(d, date == o)
  tibble(origin = o, h = h, target_date = o %m+% months(3 * h),
         model    = c("Random walk", "Mean, rolling", "Inflation only, rolling", "AR(2), rolling"),
         forecast = c(now$pi,
                      mean(tr$y_lead),
                      as.numeric(predict(lm(y_lead ~ pi, data = tr), now)),
                      as.numeric(predict(lm(y_lead ~ pi + pi_lag1, data = tr2), now))))
}))

# ---- core measures on the rolling window ----
roll_core <- imap_dfr(vint, \(v, name) map_dfr(horizons, \(h) map_dfr(origins_h(h), \(o) {
  d   <- fc_data |> filter(date <= o) |>
    left_join(v[[as.character(o)]], by = "date") |>
    mutate(y_lead = lead(pi, h))
  tr  <- train_rows(d, o, h) |> filter(!is.na(y_lead), !is.na(core))
  now <- filter(d, date == o)
  tibble(origin = o, h = h, target_date = o %m+% months(3 * h),
         model    = paste(name, c("(regression)", "(inflation + core)")),
         forecast = as.numeric(c(predict(lm(y_lead ~ core,      data = tr), now),
                                 predict(lm(y_lead ~ pi + core, data = tr), now))))
})))

roll_all <- bind_rows(roll_bench, roll_core)
roll_all <- roll_all |>
  filter(str_detect(model, "\\(regression\\)")) |>
  group_by(origin, h, target_date) |>
  summarise(forecast = mean(forecast), .groups = "drop") |>
  mutate(model = "Equal-weighted combination") |>
  bind_rows(roll_all, x = _) |>
  left_join(select(target, target_date = date, actual = pi), by = "target_date")
saveRDS(roll_all, file.path(out_dir, "forecasts_rolling.rds"))

# ---- tests ----
hac_var <- function(x, lags) {
  n <- length(x); x <- x - mean(x)
  v <- sum(x^2) / n
  for (l in seq_len(lags)) v <- v + 2 * (1 - l / (lags + 1)) * sum(x[(l + 1):n] * x[1:(n - l)]) / n
  v
}
dm_p <- function(e_bench, e_model, h) {
  d <- e_bench^2 - e_model^2; n <- length(d)
  stat <- mean(d) / sqrt(hac_var(d, h - 1) / n) * sqrt((n + 1 - 2 * h + h * (h - 1) / n) / n)
  2 * pt(-abs(stat), df = n - 1)
}
cw_p <- function(e_null, e_alt, f_null, f_alt, h) {
  adj <- e_null^2 - (e_alt^2 - (f_null - f_alt)^2); n <- length(adj)
  pnorm(-mean(adj) / sqrt(hac_var(adj, h - 1) / n))
}

refs <- c("Random walk", "Mean, rolling", "Inflation only, rolling")
errs <- roll_all |> mutate(e = actual - forecast)
ref  <- errs |> filter(model %in% refs) |>
  select(origin, h, model, e, forecast) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = model, values_from = c(e, forecast))

roll_tests <- errs |>
  filter(!model %in% refs) |>
  left_join(ref, by = c("origin", "h")) |>
  group_by(model, h) |>
  summarise(
    rmse      = sqrt(mean(e^2)),
    rel_mean  = rmse / sqrt(mean(`e_Mean, rolling`^2)),
    rel_rw    = rmse / sqrt(mean(`e_Random walk`^2)),
    p_dm_mean = dm_p(`e_Mean, rolling`, e, first(h)),
    p_dm_rw   = dm_p(`e_Random walk`,   e, first(h)),
    p_cw_mean = cw_p(`e_Mean, rolling`, e, `forecast_Mean, rolling`, forecast, first(h)),
    p_cw_infl = cw_p(`e_Inflation only, rolling`, e, `forecast_Inflation only, rolling`, forecast, first(h)),
    .groups = "drop") |>
  mutate(p_cw_mean = if_else(str_detect(model, "\\(regression\\)"),       p_cw_mean, NA_real_),
         p_cw_infl = if_else(str_detect(model, "inflation \\+ core"),     p_cw_infl, NA_real_)) |>
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric) & !h, \(x) round(x, 3))) |>
  arrange(h, rmse)
saveRDS(roll_tests, file.path(out_dir, "forecast_tests_rolling.rds"))

# reference RMSEs, then the test table
errs |> filter(model %in% refs) |>
  group_by(model, h) |> summarise(rmse = round(sqrt(mean(e^2)), 3), .groups = "drop") |>
  arrange(h, rmse) |> as.data.frame()
roll_tests |> as.data.frame()
```

## Step 14: Target-based benchmarks (glide path and inflation target)

```{r}
# Bank of Mongolia inflation target by year
# 2012: World Bank Mongolia Quarterly Brief (June 2012); 2013-2015: Monetary Policy Guidelines for 2013;
# 2016: Governor's statement (May 2016); 2017-2026: Inflation Reports and Monetary Policy Guidelines
target_hist <- tibble(year    = 2012:2026,
                      pi_star = c(10, 8, 6, 6, 7, 8, 8, 8, 8, 6, 6, 6, 6, 6, 6))
H <- 8                                                     # quarters for inflation to return to target

target <- readRDS(file.path(out_dir, "target_headline_yoy_q.rds"))
fc_all <- readRDS(file.path(out_dir, "forecasts_all.rds"))

glide <- fc_all |>
  distinct(origin, h, target_date) |>
  left_join(select(target, origin = date, pi_now = pi), by = "origin") |>
  mutate(year = year(origin)) |>
  left_join(target_hist, by = "year") |>
  transmute(origin, h, target_date,
            `Glide path`       = pi_star + (1 - pmin(h / H, 1)) * (pi_now - pi_star),
            `Inflation target` = pi_star) |>
  pivot_longer(c(`Glide path`, `Inflation target`), names_to = "model", values_to = "forecast") |>
  left_join(select(target, target_date = date, actual = pi), by = "target_date")
stopifnot(!anyNA(glide$forecast))                          # stops if a target year is still missing

fc_all <- fc_all |> filter(!model %in% c("Glide path", "Inflation target")) |> bind_rows(glide)
saveRDS(fc_all, file.path(out_dir, "forecasts_all.rds"))

# accuracy relative to the glide path, with Diebold-Mariano tests
hac_var <- function(x, lags) {
  n <- length(x); x <- x - mean(x)
  v <- sum(x^2) / n
  for (l in seq_len(lags)) v <- v + 2 * (1 - l / (lags + 1)) * sum(x[(l + 1):n] * x[1:(n - l)]) / n
  v
}
dm_p <- function(e_bench, e_model, h) {
  d <- e_bench^2 - e_model^2; n <- length(d)
  stat <- mean(d) / sqrt(hac_var(d, h - 1) / n) * sqrt((n + 1 - 2 * h + h * (h - 1) / n) / n)
  2 * pt(-abs(stat), df = n - 1)
}

gl <- fc_all |> filter(model == "Glide path") |> transmute(origin, h, e_glide = actual - forecast)

fc_all |>
  filter(!str_detect(model, "\\(level\\)|\\(gap\\)")) |>          # regression forms and benchmarks
  mutate(e = actual - forecast) |>
  left_join(gl, by = c("origin", "h")) |>
  group_by(model, h) |>
  summarise(rmse       = sqrt(mean(e^2)),
            rel_glide  = rmse / sqrt(mean(e_glide^2)),
            bias       = mean(e),
            p_vs_glide = if (cur_group()$model == "Glide path") NA_real_ else dm_p(e_glide, e, first(h)),
            .groups = "drop") |>
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric) & !h, \(x) round(x, 3))) |>
  arrange(h, rmse) |>
  as.data.frame()
```

## Step 15: Glide path starting from core instead of headline

```{r}
H  <- 8                                                     # quarters for inflation to return to target
hz <- c(2, 4, 6)                                            # at 8 quarters every glide equals the target

target_hist <- tibble(year    = 2012:2026,
                      pi_star = c(10, 8, 6, 6, 7, 8, 8, 8, 8, 6, 6, 6, 6, 6, 6))
target <- readRDS(file.path(out_dir, "target_headline_yoy_q.rds"))

exfood_q <- readRDS(here("data", "exclusion", "exfood_linked_2006.rds")) |>
  mutate(date = floor_date(date, "quarter")) |>
  group_by(date) |>
  summarise(core = mean(ex_food_yoy), n = n(), .groups = "drop") |>
  filter(n == 3, !is.na(core)) |>
  select(-n)

vint <- list("Local level" = readRDS(file.path(out_dir, "vintages_local_level.rds")),
             "SVAR"        = readRDS(file.path(out_dir, "vintages_svar.rds")),
             "DFM"         = readRDS(file.path(out_dir, "vintages_dfm.rds")))
vo <- as.Date(names(vint[["Local level"]]))                 # origins with real-time vintages
vint[["Ex-food"]] <- set_names(rep(list(exfood_q), length(vo)), as.character(vo))

cg <- map_dfr(hz, \(h) {
  o_h  <- vo[vo %m+% months(3 * h) <= max(target$date)]
  w    <- 1 - pmin(h / H, 1)                                # share of today's gap from target still remaining
  base <- tibble(origin = o_h) |>
    left_join(select(target, origin = date, pi_now = pi), by = "origin") |>
    mutate(year = year(origin)) |>
    left_join(target_hist, by = "year")
  core_now <- imap_dfr(vint, \(v, name) map_dfr(o_h, \(o) {
    vv <- v[[as.character(o)]]
    tibble(origin = o, model = paste(name, "(core glide)"), core = vv$core[vv$date == o])
  }))
  bind_rows(
    base |> transmute(origin, model = "Glide path (headline)",
                      forecast = pi_star + w * (pi_now - pi_star)),
    core_now |> left_join(base, by = "origin") |>
      transmute(origin, model, forecast = pi_star + w * (core - pi_star))
  ) |>
    mutate(h = h, target_date = origin %m+% months(3 * h))
}) |>
  left_join(select(target, target_date = date, actual = pi), by = "target_date")

# combination: glide from the average of the four core readings
cg <- cg |>
  filter(str_detect(model, "core glide")) |>
  group_by(origin, h, target_date, actual) |>
  summarise(forecast = mean(forecast), .groups = "drop") |>
  mutate(model = "Combination (core glide)") |>
  bind_rows(cg, x = _)
saveRDS(cg, file.path(out_dir, "forecasts_core_glide.rds"))

# tests against the headline glide: squared and absolute errors
hac_var <- function(x, lags) {
  n <- length(x); x <- x - mean(x)
  v <- sum(x^2) / n
  if (lags > 0) for (l in seq_len(lags)) v <- v + 2 * (1 - l / (lags + 1)) * sum(x[(l + 1):n] * x[1:(n - l)]) / n
  v
}
dm_stat_p <- function(d, h) {
  n <- length(d)
  stat <- mean(d) / sqrt(hac_var(d, h - 1) / n) * sqrt((n + 1 - 2 * h + h * (h - 1) / n) / n)
  2 * pt(-abs(stat), df = n - 1)
}

hg <- cg |> filter(model == "Glide path (headline)") |> transmute(origin, h, e_hg = actual - forecast)

cg |>
  mutate(e = actual - forecast) |>
  left_join(hg, by = c("origin", "h")) |>
  group_by(model, h) |>
  summarise(n        = n(),
            rmse     = sqrt(mean(e^2)),
            rel_rmse = rmse / sqrt(mean(e_hg^2)),
            rel_mae  = mean(abs(e)) / mean(abs(e_hg)),
            bias     = mean(e),
            p_sq     = if (cur_group()$model == "Glide path (headline)") NA_real_ else dm_stat_p(e_hg^2 - e^2, first(h)),
            p_abs    = if (cur_group()$model == "Glide path (headline)") NA_real_ else dm_stat_p(abs(e_hg) - abs(e), first(h)),
            .groups = "drop") |>
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric) & !c(h, n), \(x) round(x, 3))) |>
  arrange(h, rmse) |>
  as.data.frame()
```

## Step 16: Main specification and the Model Confidence Set

```{r}
fc_all <- readRDS(file.path(out_dir, "forecasts_all.rds"))
cg     <- readRDS(file.path(out_dir, "forecasts_core_glide.rds"))

main_models <- c("Glide path", "Inflation target", "Random walk", "AR(2)", "Historical mean",
                 "Ex-food (regression)", "Local level (regression)", "SVAR (regression)",
                 "DFM (regression)", "Equal-weighted combination")

main <- bind_rows(fc_all |> filter(model %in% main_models),
                  cg     |> filter(h == 4, model != "Glide path (headline)")) |>
  filter(!(h == 8 & model == "Inflation target"))        # at 8 quarters, identical to the glide path
saveRDS(main, file.path(out_dir, "forecasts_main_spec.rds"))
main |> count(h, model) |> count(h, n, name = "models")   # check: one sample size per horizon

mcs_run <- function(hh, loss = c("sq", "abs"), alpha = 0.10) {
  loss <- match.arg(loss)
  L <- main |>
    filter(h == hh) |>
    mutate(l = if (loss == "sq") (actual - forecast)^2 else abs(actual - forecast)) |>
    select(origin, model, l) |>
    pivot_wider(names_from = model, values_from = l) |>
    arrange(origin)
  stopifnot(!anyNA(L))
  set.seed(2026)
  m <- MCS::MCSprocedure(as.matrix(select(L, -origin)), alpha = alpha, B = 5000,
                         statistic = "Tmax", k = hh, verbose = FALSE)
  as_tibble(m@show, rownames = "model") |>
    mutate(h = hh, loss = loss, avg_loss = Loss) |>
    select(h, loss, model, rank = Rank_M, mcs_p = MCS_M, avg_loss)
}

mcs <- map_dfr(c(4, 8), \(hh) bind_rows(mcs_run(hh, "sq"), mcs_run(hh, "abs")))
saveRDS(mcs, file.path(out_dir, "model_confidence_set.rds"))
mcs |> mutate(across(c(mcs_p, avg_loss), \(x) round(x, 3))) |> as.data.frame()
```

## Step 17: Giacomini-Rossi fluctuation test (when does each measure do better or worse?)

```{r}
main    <- readRDS(file.path(out_dir, "forecasts_main_spec.rds"))
mu_frac <- 0.3                                            # rolling window: 30% of the forecasts

hac_var <- function(x, lags) {
  n <- length(x); x <- x - mean(x)
  v <- sum(x^2) / n
  if (lags > 0) for (l in seq_len(lags)) v <- v + 2 * (1 - l / (lags + 1)) * sum(x[(l + 1):n] * x[1:(n - l)]) / n
  v
}

# 5% critical value, simulated from the limiting distribution:
# sup over windows of |B(s + mu) - B(s)| / sqrt(mu), with B a standard Brownian motion
sim_cv <- function(mu, nsim = 20000, ngrid = 1000) {
  k <- round(mu * ngrid)
  stats <- replicate(nsim, {
    B <- c(0, cumsum(rnorm(ngrid, sd = sqrt(1 / ngrid))))
    max(abs(B[(k + 1):(ngrid + 1)] - B[1:(ngrid + 1 - k)])) / sqrt(mu)
  })
  unname(quantile(stats, 0.95))
}
set.seed(2026)
cv <- sim_cv(mu_frac)
round(cv, 3)

# rolling, standardized loss differential: positive = model beats the glide path
fluct <- function(hh, m, bench = "Glide path") {
  w <- main |>
    filter(h == hh, model %in% c(m, bench)) |>
    mutate(loss = (actual - forecast)^2) |>
    select(origin, model, loss) |>
    pivot_wider(names_from = model, values_from = loss) |>
    arrange(origin)
  d   <- w[[bench]] - w[[m]]
  P   <- length(d); k <- round(mu_frac * P)
  s   <- sqrt(hac_var(d, hh - 1))
  idx <- seq_len(P - k + 1)
  tibble(h     = hh, model = m,
         date  = w$origin[idx + floor(k / 2)],            # center of each window
         stat  = map_dbl(idx, \(i) sum(d[i:(i + k - 1)]) / (s * sqrt(k))))
}

pairs <- bind_rows(
  expand_grid(h = c(4, 8), model = c("Ex-food (regression)", "Local level (regression)", "SVAR (regression)",
                                     "DFM (regression)", "Equal-weighted combination")),
  tibble(h = 4, model = "SVAR (core glide)"))

fl <- pmap_dfr(pairs, \(h, model) fluct(h, model))
saveRDS(fl, file.path(out_dir, "fluctuation_test.rds"))

# summary: did any window show a significant difference, and when?
fl |>
  group_by(model, h) |>
  summarise(max_stat = max(stat), date_max = date[which.max(stat)],
            min_stat = min(stat), date_min = date[which.min(stat)],
            sig_better = any(stat >  cv), sig_worse = any(stat < -cv), .groups = "drop") |>
  mutate(across(c(max_stat, min_stat), \(x) round(x, 2))) |>
  arrange(h, model) |>
  as.data.frame()

p_fl <- fl |>
  ggplot(aes(date, stat)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = c(-cv, cv), linetype = "dashed", colour = "#c0504d") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, colour = "grey60") +
  geom_line() +
  facet_grid(model ~ paste(h, "quarters ahead")) +
  labs(x = "Centre of 16-quarter window (forecast origin)",
       y = "Rolling relative accuracy vs. glide path",
       caption = "Above the upper dashed line: significantly better than the glide path in that window; below the lower line: significantly worse (Giacomini and Rossi 2010).") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 10) +
  theme(plot.caption = element_text(hjust = 0, colour = "grey30"),
        strip.text.y = element_text(angle = 0))
p_fl
ggsave(here("output", "evaluation_figures", "fluctuation_test.png"), p_fl, width = 9, height = 10, dpi = 300)
```

```{r}
vint <- list("Local level" = readRDS(file.path(out_dir, "vintages_local_level.rds")),

  imap_dfr(v, \(vv, o) tibble(measure  = name,

    left_join(final, by = "date")
})

revisions |>

  group_by(measure) |>

            mean_rev     = mean(rev),          # positive: later estimate higher

            max_abs_rev  = max(abs(rev)),
```

## Step 19: Summary table, core measures against each benchmark

```{r}
fc_all <- readRDS(file.path(out_dir, "forecasts_all.rds"))
aug    <- readRDS(file.path(out_dir, "forecasts_augmented.rds"))

hac_var <- function(x, lags) {
  n <- length(x); x <- x - mean(x)
  v <- sum(x^2) / n
  if (lags > 0) for (l in seq_len(lags)) v <- v + 2 * (1 - l / (lags + 1)) * sum(x[(l + 1):n] * x[1:(n - l)]) / n
  v
}
dm_p <- function(e_bench, e_model, h) {
  d <- e_bench^2 - e_model^2; n <- length(d)
  stat <- mean(d) / sqrt(hac_var(d, h - 1) / n) * sqrt((n + 1 - 2 * h + h * (h - 1) / n) / n)
  2 * pt(-abs(stat), df = n - 1)
}
cw_p <- function(e_null, e_alt, f_null, f_alt, h) {
  adj <- e_null^2 - (e_alt^2 - (f_null - f_alt)^2); n <- length(adj)
  pnorm(-mean(adj) / sqrt(hac_var(adj, h - 1) / n))
}
stars <- function(p) case_when(p < 0.01 ~ "***", p < 0.05 ~ "**", p < 0.10 ~ "*", TRUE ~ "")

core_models <- c("Ex-food (regression)", "Local level (regression)", "SVAR (regression)",
                 "DFM (regression)", "Equal-weighted combination")
benches     <- c("Random walk", "Historical mean", "Glide path")

err <- fc_all |>
  filter(model %in% c(core_models, benches)) |>
  transmute(origin, h, model, e = actual - forecast, forecast)

# 1. each core measure against each benchmark
vs_bench <- expand_grid(m = core_models, b = benches, hh = c(4, 8)) |>
  pmap_dfr(\(m, b, hh) {
    d <- inner_join(filter(err, model == m, h == hh),
                    filter(err, model == b, h == hh),
                    by = "origin", suffix = c("", "_b"))
    nested <- b == "Historical mean" && str_detect(m, "regression")   # Clark-West for nested pairs
    p <- if (nested) cw_p(d$e_b, d$e, d$forecast_b, d$forecast, hh) else dm_p(d$e_b, d$e, hh)
    tibble(model = m, column = b, h = hh,
           rel = sqrt(mean(d$e^2)) / sqrt(mean(d$e_b^2)), p = p)
  })

# 2. inflation + core against inflation alone
adds <- aug |>
  mutate(e_null = actual - f_null, e_alt = actual - f_alt) |>
  group_by(measure, h) |>
  summarise(rel = sqrt(mean(e_alt^2)) / sqrt(mean(e_null^2)),
            p   = cw_p(e_null, e_alt, f_null, f_alt, first(h)), .groups = "drop") |>
  transmute(model = paste(measure, "(regression)"), column = "Adds to current inflation", h, rel, p)

# 3. the table: relative RMSE with significance stars
table6 <- bind_rows(vs_bench, adds) |>
  mutate(cell   = sprintf("%.2f%s", rel, stars(p)),
         model  = str_remove(model, " \\(regression\\)"),
         column = factor(column, levels = c(benches, "Adds to current inflation"))) |>
  select(h, model, column, cell) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = column, values_from = cell) |>
  arrange(h, factor(model, levels = str_remove(core_models, " \\(regression\\)")))

# benchmark RMSEs, for the bottom row of each panel
bench_rmse <- err |> filter(model %in% benches) |>
  group_by(h, model) |> summarise(rmse = round(sqrt(mean(e^2)), 2), .groups = "drop")

saveRDS(list(table = table6, bench_rmse = bench_rmse, raw = bind_rows(vs_bench, adds)),
        file.path(out_dir, "table6_core_vs_benchmarks.rds"))
table6 |> as.data.frame()
bench_rmse |> as.data.frame()
```
